title: Schema migration: engagement_rate Decimal(5,2) → Decimal(7,2)
acceptance: 新建 prisma/migrations/<timestamp>_kol_engagement_rate_decimal_7_2/migration.sql 含 ALTER TABLE kol ALTER COLUMN engagement_rate TYPE NUMERIC(7, 2)
migration.sql 含 -- ROLLBACK: 注释 (per v0.9.22 #22 BL-070 沉淀) + warning '先 UPDATE clamp 再 ALTER' (因为 rollback 到 5,2 会触发 overflow 如有 > 999.99 值)
prisma/schema.prisma engagementRate 改 @db.Decimal(5, 2) → @db.Decimal(7, 2)
npx prisma migrate dev 本地验证 + npx prisma generate 重生 client
staging deploy-staging.sh npx prisma migrate deploy 验证 (PASS, 不丢现有 1397 KOL 数据)
L1 npx tsc --noEmit PASS (Prisma client type 同步)

title: adapter clamp engagementRate (max 99999.99) + engagement_outlier flag
acceptance: src/lib/kol-sync/adapters/apify-kol.ts:409 改为先算 rawEngagementRate, 然后 Math.min(rawRate, 99999.99) clamp 到 Decimal(7,2) 上限
engagementOutlier 变量 = rawEngagementRate != null && rawEngagementRate > 100 (业务语义: >100% engagement 在 percentage 上不合理)
adapter return 加 engagement_outlier 字段; src/lib/kol-sync/types.ts KolSyncAdapterOutput interface 加 engagement_outlier?: boolean
src/lib/kol-sync/import.ts mapToUpsertPayload 把 raw.engagement_outlier 写入 metadata.flags.engagement_outlier (true/false)

单测 src/lib/kol-sync/adapters/__tests__/apify-kol.test.ts ≥3 case: rawRate 5.5 → engagementRate=5.5 outlier=false / rawRate 150 → engagementRate=150 outlier=true / rawRate 1,000,000 → engagementRate=99999.99 (clamped) outlier=true
L1 PASS (lint + tsc + vitest)

title: import.ts per-KOL try/catch + audit_log kol.import_failed
acceptance: src/lib/kol-sync/import.ts upsert 调用包 try/catch: 单 KOL fail 不抛, stats.failed++, audit_log kol.import_failed 写入 (含 platform/externalId/displayName/followerCount/engagementRate/error_msg truncated 500 chars)
import.ts ImportStats interface 加 failed: number 字段 (初始 0)
scripts/kol-sync-daily.ts 最终 stats 报告含 failed=<N> + alerts 加 failed>0 触发 'errors=N' 同 outer try/catch
audit_log 写入本身失败 → 不抛 (避免 recursive failure), 仅 console.error
单测 src/lib/kol-sync/__tests__/import.test.ts ≥3 case: upsert mock 抛错 → stats.failed=1 + audit_log 写一次 / upsert 成功 → stats.failed=0 audit_log 不写 / audit_log 写入也失败 → 不抛仅 console.error
L1 PASS

title: 14 天遗漏 KOL backfill — SSH prod 跑 daily-sync 验证修复
acceptance: SSH prod 'cd /opt/kolmatrix && npm run kol-sync:daily 2>&1 | tail -40' 跑成功 (report level != WARN/ERROR for numeric overflow)
stats.inserted >= 1 (有新 KOL 进入)
stats.failed = 0 (修复生效, 无 overflow throw)
如 stats.inserted 数远小于 14 天预期遗漏 (如 < 200): 说明 apify-kol 已 shift window, 永久遗漏的 KOL 不再追, 记录在 audit doc
抽样 10-15 个 last_synced_at > BL-076 deploy 的新 KOL 人工 review 数据完整性 (followers / categories / handle 字段)
新建 docs/test-reports/BL-076-backfill-2026-05-27.md 报告 (含 stats / 抽样 / 14 天遗漏 KOL 估计数)
